name: Kubernetes MCP Server
description: Lets agents manage Kubernetes and OpenShift clusters through a native Go MCP server that talks to the API directly: pods, any resource, events, Helm, and optional toolsets.

skills.name: Pod Operations
skills.description: Lists, gets, deletes, and execs into pods, shows pod logs and resource usage, and runs container images as new pods.

skills.name: Generic Resource CRUD
skills.description: Creates, updates, gets, lists, and deletes any Kubernetes or OpenShift resource, including custom resources, via the API.

skills.name: Helm Releases
skills.description: Installs Helm charts, lists releases across namespaces, and uninstalls releases in the current or a chosen namespace.

skills.name: Events and Namespaces
skills.description: Lists cluster events for troubleshooting, plus Kubernetes namespaces and OpenShift projects, with field selector filters.
